gates.name: Two-project isolation

gates.name: Durable recovery

gates.name: Budget safety
gates.evidence: Anonymous exact-zero routes, no credentials or payment flow, ForgeZero and spending tests; no unapproved paid inference.

gates.name: Privacy

gates.name: ForgeAAA regression
